As Rascal places the jar near the stump, two elder female mice approach him, their bodies adorned from head to paw with intricate tattoos. They gesture for Rascal to lie down.

One mouse working on Rascal’s thighs trail off, settling between his legs. They explore his sheath and move down to his balls. The mouse strokes them lovingly for just a moment, before one of the elders scolds them.

When he lowers his head, the mice gently place leaves over his eyes. With his vision obscured, Rascal focuses on the sounds around him. The pitter-patter of tiny paws fills the air, growing louder as more mice join in.
As the leaves are lifted from Rascal's eyes, he looks down and sees intricate swirls and shapes perfectly mirrored across his body. Nearby, a few mice beam with pride at their handiwork.
A floral aroma pierces Rascal's nostrils as the mice begin grinding something. One of the elders barks out commands, and the air fills with citrus and a trace of mint.
“Thank you!” Rascal says, while one of the mice leads him toward the campfire. More mice gather around, watching intently as the elders take turns tossing various items into the fire.
Small paws move methodically over Rascal's body, tracing bold strokes and intricate swirls. The mice work in perfect harmony.
Across the clearing, the stump housing Mabel glows with a steady rhythm, each pulse casting vibrant light. With every burst of color, the campfire’s flames respond in unison.
The elder mice's chants become louder! Pink flames and streaks explode out from the campfire! As this happens, the group of mice pair off and begin kissing.
The flames die down as the ritual comes to an end. Exhausted and dripping mice motion for Rascal to follow them to a nearby creek.
Two mice climb on Rascal and begin exploring his snout. “I’ll just follow their lead” thinks Rascal, as they smooch around his lips. He lightly caresses the mice and brings them in closer.
They wash up and return to the campfire...

The three take turns making out and exploring each other. Rascal gets bolder with his tongue, and the mice reflect his energy. And then, the trees alight with a brilliant red. And the ritual begins...

Wait, but what are you doing with it?
[pic=5]Oh uhh, it’s a whole thing. Go ask Mabel, she’ll fill ya in!

Maverick just told me about
some thing you two are doing?
Something with a lot of donkey cum?
[pic=6]Haha! Yessir, you came to the right place!
[pic=1]Ya trying to get frisky with the critters?
[pic=4]Or if you’re looking to relax, we’ve got plenty of treatment options!
I actually have no idea what this is.

No, he had to go.
He told me you’d fill me in.
[pic=6]This is a pretty recent endeavor Maverick and I’ve cooked up!
[pic=6]As ya know, I have a lot of connections with some of the smaller critters of the forest.
[pic=6]Not only the rodents, but the birds too! There’s a whole network of us lil’ guys!
[pic=3]Wouldn’t ya know it, they are just as horny as you guys, in fact, probably more so!
[pic=7]See most of the smaller critters don’t really experience things with larger critters. Maybe occasionally with someone your size.
[pic=4]That went even better than I expected!
[pic=1]Thanks for being such a willing participant!

Anytime! Really that’s
quite the charming bunch!
[pic=6]Right? That’s some of our regulars, and some of my long time friends too!
[pic=1]Actually, a few asked if I could arrange some one on one time with you…
[pic=1]One thing at a time though… First I’ve got to chat with Oliver!
[pic=3]But someone like Oliver? No that’s quite rare!
[pic=6]Some of the smaller critters are quite afraid of larger ones, though you and I know they are harmless.
[pic=4]So I thought, here we go. This can be an opportunity to help bridge that gap!
[pic=4]Why not share some of the “experiences” a small critter can have when paired up with a much larger partner!
[pic=6]Thus, the Critter Cum Spa was born!
[pic=1]Yeah! Don’t worry, the name grows on ya.
[pic=6]Maverick collects the spunk! Then we mix it with some additives just to keep it from getting funky over time.
[pic=6]Then we fill up baths, set up heated channels to keep things nice and warm.
[pic=4]And the critters are free to join as they please!

Whoa, that sounds like
quite the operation!
[pic=1]Yeah, we’ve got some friends who helped set the whole thing up. I’m sure you’ll meet them later.
[pic=6]Anyways, it started as an aphrodisiac sorta experience. But some of the regulars swear by the beauty benefits.
[pic=4]Yeah! It helps moisturize the fur and keep your coat lively!
[pic=3]Some critters swear by it! They say their skin is much tighter and rejuvenated!
[pic=3]I think they just wanna have cum on their face, but who am I to judge.
[pic=1]The smaller critters have really taken to it. But we haven’t yet moved onto step two of the project…
[pic=7]Well, the whole point is to help integrate smaller and larger critters.
[pic=3]So we want to eventually bring in the larger critters.
[pic=4]Fresher product, hands on experience, safe and secure integration!
[pic=1]At least, that’s the plan. We just haven’t pulled the trigger yet…
[pic=7]I think I’m just a little nervous… Some of these smaller critters are quite skiddish.

Maybe you should give
them a bit more credit?
[pic=7]It’s just a little different when a larger critter is actually in the picture…
[pic=3]They were a bit scared of him at first, but they’ve definitely warmed up.

How about I go next? I’m sure
the more critters they meet,
the easier it will become!
[pic=6]Come with me, I’ll see what I can do!
[pic=1]Oh! My magazine! Let’s see… Issue 68, good good.
[pic=2]I actually remember when this one came out!
[pic=3]My favorite was the week just after this, but this one’s good too.
[pic=2]Mmmm, see this Grizzly? Hoo-wheee~! What a hunk!
[pic=2]They’re makin’ out and… what do you kids call it these days?
[pic=2]mmm… I’d love to be sandwiched between those two…
[pic=2]Heh… I’ve got a thing for the Asian critters…
[pic=1]Oooh… I forgot, this issue has a large section on Pandas…
[pic=1]They’ve got this double feature of this polar bear and a black bear!
[pic=3]Oh! Aren’t you an Asian critter? Huh!
[pic=3]And check out the balls on this Brown!
[pic=1]Think she’d mind if I watch her try the toy out?
[pic=3]So the Bear liked my eggplant idea?
[pic=2]I’ll have to share more of my advice with her…
[pic=3]Hm… y’know… she’s the only one I’m not… intimately familiar with…
[pic=1]We swung with the couple a few times~! Let me tell ya, that bear had stamina!
[pic=2]Once you’ve seen a bear carry a beaver, you’ve seen it all, trust me!
[pic=3]Nothin’ quite like being handled by a bear…
[pic=2]Phew, ok, I’ve gotta get my head out of the clouds, I’ve got work to do!
[pic=2]The Beaver just told me about the Playbear you got him!
[pic=3]That takes me way back! We used to drool over the hunks in these magazines for fun!
[pic=1]Somethin’ tells me we won’t be seeing our beaver for a bit~
[pic=1]Y’know way back in the day, he used to be seeing a great big grizzly!
[pic=3]Oooh, I heard you helped the mouse find her string!
[pic=1]She told me all about her plans, and I am so excited to see her tie herself up!
[pic=3]… Oh actually… She’ll probably need some help, I’ll offer an extra pair of paws next time I see her.
[pic=2]She’s gonna be just the cutest lil’ wrapped up thing~!
[pic=1]… On second thought, maybe I’ll give those rods another go…
[pic=3]Sounding huh? That’s what he ended up liking?
[pic=1]Well heck, I’ve got some spare rods, can’t say I was ever a fan of that…
Something is carved in the tree here…
